theorem QOU.Archimedean.HyperbolicVolume.inscribedTriangle_vertex_incidence {R t α β γ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hβ0 : 0 < β) (hγ0 : 0 < γ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi) :
((circlePoint R t).1 * Real.cos (t + γ) + (circlePoint R t).2 * Real.sin (t + γ) = R * Real.cos γ ∧ (circlePoint R t).1 * Real.cos (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α + β) + (circlePoint R t).2 * Real.sin (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α + β) = R * Real.cos β ∧ circlePoint R t ∈ chordHalfplane R (t + 2 * γ + α) α) ∧ ((circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ)).1 * Real.cos (t + γ) + (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ)).2 * Real.sin (t + γ) = R * Real.cos γ ∧ (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ)).1 * Real.cos (t + 2 * γ + α) + (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ)).2 * Real.sin (t + 2 * γ + α) = R * Real.cos α ∧ circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ) ∈ chordHalfplane R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α + β) β) ∧ (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α)).1 * Real.cos (t + 2 * γ + α) + (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α)).2 * Real.sin (t + 2 * γ + α) = R * Real.cos α ∧ (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α)).1 * Real.cos (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α + β) + (circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α)).2 * Real.sin (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α + β) = R * Real.cos β ∧ circlePoint R (t + 2 * γ + 2 * α) ∈ chordHalfplane R (t + γ) γ
